ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly high-intensity white pixels occupying approximately 85-90% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted against low-intensity black borders and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white surface area with a continuous black pigmented border along the trailing edge. Distinct circular black focal spots are distributed across both lobes (3 on the right, 2-3 on the left). A large, irregular black pigmentation cluster is localized at the insertion point of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring variable pixel-depth notches and irregular peaks isolated from the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple discrete, circular high-contrast dark spots (rosettes) distributed across the mid-region of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular dark scarring or pigmentation mass localized at the base of the median notch. Dense, high-contrast white textured clusters (barnacles) are present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'tattered' appearance of the lobe tips due to heavy biological encrustation extending beyond the soft tissue margins.
